proves: RFC 0008 runtime migration execution remains unimplemented: a `migration from 1 to 2 { state => { self.count = 99 } }` transform still never runs, so the fresh-spawned v2 entity reports count 0. Compiler artifact work now preserves validated migration topology in ActorMeta rather than dropping it, but spawned actors do not yet retain authoritative schema identity, persistence records do not yet stamp origin schema versions, and recovery performs no migration-chain dispatch or execution. The remaining gap is runtime/persistence execution semantics, not parser acceptance or manifest topology.
